narrative.details:
Wait, wait, don't go yet!

I know I said I just needed the key but... well, they caught me once, they could do it again, right? I'm just one goblin, and there's hundreds of trolls around here!

You've already put enough of a dent in their numbers to get this key, so it should be easy enough to stand guard while we mosey on out of here, huh?
narrative.objectives: Escort Zimmix Sputterspark away from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda then tell Wharfmaster Lozgil in Booty Bay of your successful rescue.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 35, 5,500 XP in all.

quests.name: Where's the Key?
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Primitive Key obtained from the trolls at the Ruins of Zul'kunda in Stranglethorn Vale to Zimmix Sputterspark.
